title: Lincoln rear seat and floor deep clean
summary: Loose dirt around the rear floor, seat base and back of the center console.
before: Loose dirt and debris are visible on the rear floor and around the back of the center console.
after: The rear floor is visibly clearer, with loose debris removed from the photographed footwell. The seat base and floor can be compared from a similar angle.
focus: Rear footwell, floor edges and the area behind the front seats. These small spaces are easy to overlook when the main concern is the seats.
decision: Loose crumbs and surface dirt may fit Interior Only. Dirt worked into fabric calls for a discussion about Deep Clean & Protect and its carpet and upholstery extraction.
note: The photos document the visible result. They do not establish the extraction method, treatment time or exact package used on this job.

title: Chevrolet front cabin cleanup
summary: A closer look at the driver’s floor mat, front seat and center console.
before: Dirt is visible on the driver’s floor mat, with the front seat, steering wheel and console in view.
after: The after image shows a cleaner-looking driver’s footwell and a clearer view of the seat and console surfaces. The open-door perspective makes those areas easy to compare.
focus: The floor mat and the spaces around the driver’s seat and console. Surface cleaning and attention to these edges are different from treating a stain embedded in upholstery.
decision: Interior Only covers vacuuming and surface cleaning. If your vehicle also needs exterior care, Essential Detail adds the hand wash and basic spray wax.
note: Lighting differs between the photographs. This example does not claim stain restoration, leather repair or a particular product.

title: Range Rover exterior cleanup
summary: The rear quarter, lower bodywork and wheel before and after exterior cleaning.
before: Road dirt is visible along the lower white bodywork and rear area.
after: The lower panels look cleaner in the after photograph. Water remains on the driveway, and light and camera position differ between the two views.
focus: The rear quarter and lower body panels. Dirt removal is visible here; paint correction, scratch removal and coating durability cannot be judged from this pair.
decision: For a regularly maintained vehicle needing care inside and out, Essential Detail includes an exterior hand wash, wheel cleaning and basic spray wax. Deep Clean & Protect adds deeper cabin cleaning, paint decontamination and upgraded sealant.
note: The package links describe currently available services, not a claim about the exact package or protective product used on this Range Rover.

title: Lexus tan interior detail
summary: Two views of the tan front seats, dashboard and center console.
before: The first photograph looks across the tan front seats toward the console and driver’s side.
after: The finished view looks into the cabin from a different position, showing the dashboard, front seats and console together.
focus: Light-colored seating and the contact areas around the front console. The photographs are useful for viewing the cabin finish, but the different angles do not establish a precise stain-by-stain comparison.
decision: Choose Interior Only for vacuuming and a surface refresh. If fabric needs extraction or the cabin needs standard stain and pet-hair treatment, compare Deep Clean & Protect before requesting a detail.
note: No leather restoration, recoloring, odor-removal guarantee or change to the photographed finish is claimed.

title: Tesla rear cabin refresh
summary: Black rear seating, floor mat and door-entry area in a close before-and-after view.
before: The rear bench, floor mat and entry sill are visible, including debris and marks in the floor area.
after: The after photograph shows the same rear-cabin layout with a tidier-looking floor mat and entry area. The bench remains in view for context.
focus: The rear floor mat and doorway, where shoes and daily use leave visible dirt. This is a modest everyday cleanup example, rather than a claim of heavy stain restoration.
decision: A cabin that mainly needs vacuuming and surface cleaning may suit Interior Only. Essential Detail adds exterior care when you also want the body, wheels and tires cleaned.
note: The images do not establish odor removal, disinfection or a specific treatment process. Send photos of your own cabin to discuss what it needs.
